articles.title: Wait, Is the Universe Slowing Down? A Scientist Says Dark Energy Might Not Be Real
articles.summary: A scientist looked at exploding stars and found something weird: the universe might not be speeding up after all. He thinks we just measured it wrong because we're moving through space. If he's right, dark energy might not exist.

articles.title: A Time Capsule for 2276: What Would You Send to the Future?
articles.summary: On America's 250th birthday, a super-strong time capsule will be buried in Philadelphia. It's packed with treasures from all 50 states—like a diamond, a whale bone, and an AI prediction—and won't be opened for 250 years.

articles.title: Country Music Takes Over! For the First Time, the Top 5 Songs Are All Country
articles.summary: This summer, country songs are everywhere. For the first time ever, the five most popular songs in America are all country hits—led by Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas,' which has been number one for 16 weeks.
